### [`v3.3.0`](https://redirect.github.com/rootless-containers/rootlesskit/releases/tag/v3.3.0)

[Compare Source](https://redirect.github.com/rootless-containers/rootlesskit/compare/v3.2.0...v3.3.0)

##### Changes

- `builtin` port driver: fix source IP propagation (v3.2.0 regression) ([#​649](https://redirect.github.com/rootless-containers/rootlesskit/issues/649))
- Go API: add `Close` to `Client` ([#​646](https://redirect.github.com/rootless-containers/rootlesskit/issues/646), thanks to [@​thaJeztah](https://redirect.github.com/thaJeztah))

Full changes: <https://github.com/rootless-containers/rootlesskit/pulls?q=is%3Apr+state%3Aclosed+milestone%3Av3.3.0>

Thanks to [@​haytok](https://redirect.github.com/haytok) [@​thaJeztah](https://redirect.github.com/thaJeztah)

##### Install

```
mkdir -p ~/bin
curl -sSL https://github.com/rootless-containers/rootlesskit/releases/download/v3.3.0/rootlesskit-$(uname -m).tar.gz | tar Cxzv ~/bin
```

##### About the binaries

The binaries were built automatically on GitHub Actions.
See the log to verify SHA256SUMS.
<https://github.com/rootless-containers/rootlesskit/actions/runs/38497743132>
The sha256sum of the SHA256SUMS file itself is 2f4fc736e73d8e0c4368395ba4bdc651140fef573ee02b58e4deecfc88217df3 .

### [`v3.2.0`](https://redirect.github.com/rootless-containers/rootlesskit/releases/tag/v3.2.0)

[Compare Source](https://redirect.github.com/rootless-containers/rootlesskit/compare/v3.1.0...v3.2.0)

##### Changes

- port/builtin: switch from iptables to nft for transparent routing ([#​613](https://redirect.github.com/rootless-containers/rootlesskit/issues/613), thanks to [@​Akshitguptaa](https://redirect.github.com/Akshitguptaa))
- net/pasta: fix IPv6 support etc. ([#​620](https://redirect.github.com/rootless-containers/rootlesskit/issues/620) [#​640](https://redirect.github.com/rootless-containers/rootlesskit/issues/640), thanks to [@​haytok](https://redirect.github.com/haytok))
- port/pesto: support IPv6 ([#​629](https://redirect.github.com/rootless-containers/rootlesskit/issues/629), thanks to [@​haytok](https://redirect.github.com/haytok))
- net/gvisor-tap-vsock, port/gvisor-tap-vsock: improve TCP throughput ([#​630](https://redirect.github.com/rootless-containers/rootlesskit/issues/630))
- parent: exclude the own UID/GID from the subid ranges to address [#​476](https://redirect.github.com/rootless-containers/rootlesskit/issues/476) ([#​623](https://redirect.github.com/rootless-containers/rootlesskit/issues/623), thanks to [@​AbhinavMir](https://redirect.github.com/AbhinavMir))

Full changes: <https://github.com/rootless-containers/rootlesskit/milestone/22?closed=1>
Thanks to [@​AbhinavMir](https://redirect.github.com/AbhinavMir) [@​Akshitguptaa](https://redirect.github.com/Akshitguptaa) [@​haytok](https://redirect.github.com/haytok)

##### Install

```
mkdir -p ~/bin
curl -sSL https://github.com/rootless-containers/rootlesskit/releases/download/v3.2.0/rootlesskit-$(uname -m).tar.gz | tar Cxzv ~/bin
```

### [`v3.0.0`](https://redirect.github.com/rootless-containers/rootlesskit/releases/tag/v3.0.0)

[Compare Source](https://redirect.github.com/rootless-containers/rootlesskit/compare/v2.3.6...v3.0.0)

##### Changes

- Add `gvisor-tap-vsock` network and port drivers ([#​515](https://redirect.github.com/rootless-containers/rootlesskit/issues/515) [#​522](https://redirect.github.com/rootless-containers/rootlesskit/issues/522), thanks to [@​fahedouch](https://redirect.github.com/fahedouch))
- Preserve real client source IP in builtin port driver via IP_TRANSPARENT ([#​565](https://redirect.github.com/rootless-containers/rootlesskit/issues/565), [#​577](https://redirect.github.com/rootless-containers/rootlesskit/issues/577))
  - For Docker, preserving the source IP requires running `dockerd-rootless.sh` with `--userland-proxy=false`
- rootlesskit-docker-proxy: postpone removal to v4 ([#​569](https://redirect.github.com/rootless-containers/rootlesskit/issues/569))
- Add build tags ([#​533](https://redirect.github.com/rootless-containers/rootlesskit/issues/533), thanks to [@​fahedouch](https://redirect.github.com/fahedouch))

Full changes: <https://github.com/rootless-containers/rootlesskit/milestone/16?closed=1>
Thanks to [@​arshia-rgh](https://redirect.github.com/arshia-rgh) [@​fahedouch](https://redirect.github.com/fahedouch) [@​yoshikawa](https://redirect.github.com/yoshikawa)
